type: genuine versioned source/key precision correction before expanded readers

old_question.question: Does Shadows of the Dahan's Range-ignoring targeting ability extend a numeric Range arrow within a Power's effect text? How does a general Power Range boost differ?

new_question.question: Does Shadows of the Dahan's Range-ignoring targeting ability extend a numeric Range arrow within a Power's effect text? How does a general Power Range boost differ?

old_key.answer: No. Shadows' conditional targeting ability changes only the numeric Range used to choose the land target, leaving internal Range arrows unchanged. General Power Range boosts apply to all Range arrows in that Power, including those within its effects; neither waives other source/target restrictions.

new_key.answer: No. Shadows' conditional targeting ability changes only the numeric Range used to choose the land target, leaving internal Range arrows unchanged. General Power Range bonuses can affect printed Range values in a Power's targeting box and effect text, subject to all restrictions, but do not increase a Range bonus itself and do not apply to another Spirit's Powers merely because they target the boosted Spirit. Neither waives other source/target restrictions.

reason: The broad Core FAQ all-Range-arrows sentence linked to a primary entry containing essential not-a-bonus and ownership qualifiers. Those exact linked primary sources and original Reaching Grasp face now resolve the limit. Basic asked targeting-vs-internal rule stays the same; old broad expected wording is not silently changed.
